title: Nice Size
text:
Nice Size. *Edited 3/17/19: This fryer worked nicely for about 3 months. The machine would not power up at all today. We tried everything we could do as far as trouble shooting. I am so disappointed!

Original Review: This is large sized air fryer. With a family of four, this larger capacity is helpful. I found the directions to be a little difficult to understand, but it didn't take too long to figure out the basics. My first attempt was home made french fries. Those didn't turn out as well as I had hoped. The cooking was uneven. I wondered if the potatoes needed to be blanched first. Frozen french fries worked out much better. I made fried chicken in it and that was amazing!! It definitely takes getting used to and trying to figure out the right times and temperatures. Overall, cooking times are shorter than in the oven. As far as clean up goes, it is easy although some of the nooks and crannies are a little challenging to reach. I really like the window so you can see how things are coming along. There's also a stirring blade which I haven't used either. So far I am pleased with it and like how it works.
